note: Extensible starting library. Presets are original descriptive recipes, not a finite list of all possible visual styles. Live-action labels are references for grading/framing; this procedural engine cannot synthesize photoreal footage.

presets.name: Documentary natural
presets.visual_language: observational framing, restrained graphics, editorial labels
presets.camera: steady handheld or locked-off; purposeful slow push-ins
presets.motion: subtle parallax and restrained title reveals
presets.editing: measured cuts, J/L cuts, evidence-led inserts
presets.sound: clean dialogue, room tone, restrained ambience

presets.name: UGC authentic
presets.visual_language: casual direct address, imperfect framing cues, close product/action inserts
presets.editing: cold open, jump cuts, reaction inserts, captions
presets.sound: clear conversational voice, subtle taps and whooshes

presets.name: Cinematic noir
presets.visual_language: hard shadows, high contrast, negative space
presets.motion: slow masks, light sweeps, restrained grain overlays
presets.editing: deliberate holds, hard cuts, occasional impact

presets.name: Cyberpunk neon
presets.visual_language: glowing geometry, grid lines, futuristic interface
presets.motion: glow pulses, scan lines, HUD reveals
presets.editing: fast cuts, glitch accents used sparingly, speed ramps

presets.name: Retro analog
presets.camera: static poster-like layouts and simulated zoom
presets.motion: flicker, grain overlay, analog title wipes
presets.sound: soft tape hiss and era-appropriate licensed music

presets.name: Flat vector explainer
presets.visual_language: simple shapes, icon systems, clean hierarchy
presets.motion: staggered reveals, shape morphs, path animation

presets.name: Kinetic typography
presets.visual_language: oversized type, expressive scale and alignment
presets.motion: word reveals, tracking changes, masks, bounce easing
presets.editing: beat cuts, phrase-based pacing, intentional pauses

presets.name: Infographic data story
presets.visual_language: charts, labels, maps, timelines and annotations
presets.camera: guided pan and zoom across evidence
presets.motion: number counters, chart builds, callout paths

presets.name: Food editorial
presets.visual_language: ingredient labels, macro crop references, clean recipe cards
presets.motion: ingredient callouts, step reveals, timer/countdown graphics
presets.sound: clean narration, foley accents, gentle music

presets.name: Sports hype
presets.visual_language: bold score graphics, player/stat callouts, dramatic framing
presets.motion: scoreboard wipes, stat builds, speed-line accents
presets.editing: cold open, escalating montage, replay beat, payoff
presets.sound: impact hits, crowd ambience only when licensed or supplied

presets.name: News explainer
presets.visual_language: clear lower thirds, maps, dates, source cards
presets.motion: timeline builds, map paths, data callouts
presets.editing: what happened, context, evidence, what next

presets.name: Paper cut collage
presets.visual_language: cut-paper shapes, visible paper edges, handmade layout
presets.motion: layered slides, paper flips, cutout reveals

presets.name: Clay stop-motion inspired
presets.motion: stepped pose changes and deliberate holds

presets.name: Luxury product graphics
presets.visual_language: minimal product pedestal, reflections, generous negative space
presets.camera: slow orbit and macro simulated moves
presets.motion: soft light sweeps and precision reveals
presets.editing: slow reveal, detail inserts, elegant payoff

presets.name: Anime-inspired original illustration
presets.visual_language: original stylized characters, expressive silhouettes, graphic speed lines
presets.motion: pose holds, impact frames, speed-line sweeps
presets.editing: action beats, reaction closeups, impact cuts
presets.sound: original/supplied effects; do not imitate copyrighted score

presets.name: Pixel arcade
presets.visual_language: pixel grids, sprite-like original figures, HUD
presets.motion: sprite steps, tile wipes, score counters

presets.name: Abstract generative
presets.editing: music-reactive cuts where audio analysis exists
presets.sound: licensed music or original generated-by-code tones
